root.label: Israel supplies Argentina during Falklands War

events.label: Israel supplies Argentina during Falklands War

slots.name: request to stop
slots.sentence: Foreign Secretary Geoffrey Howe personally asked Israel to stop, but his request was ignored.

slots.name: arms route
slots.sentence: Israeli arms were also routed through Peru so that the UK would not find out.

slots.name: admission date
slots.sentence: Israel denied involvement at first but, by 1984, admitted to supplying Argentina in order to sustain its arms industry.

slots.name: arms sales status
slots.sentence: According to declassified British files, Israel sold Argentina weapons including Skyhawk jets, which killed dozens of British troops.
